headline:

Undergraduate in Mathematics
bioMarkdown:
I am an undergraduate in Mathematics at **SICAU**, with expected graduation in **2028**.

I am currently a Research Assistant in [Prof. Taku Komura’s group](https://www.cs.hku.hk/index.php/people/academic-staff/taku) at **The University of Hong Kong** ([Miro Dynamics–HKU CGVU Joint Lab](https://hku-cg.github.io/mirod-lab/)). Previously, I was a Research Assistant in [Prof. Bo Zhao’s](https://soai.sjtu.edu.cn/cn/facultydetails/zzjs/zhaobo) [MINT Lab](https://mint-sjtu.github.io/) at **Shanghai Jiao Tong University** (**2025–2026**).

researchInterestsMarkdown:
My research interests lie in **robot learning and general-purpose embodied intelligence**. I am particularly interested in:

- **Generalist Robot Learning:** VLA, WAM, and scalable learning of general-purpose robot policies.
- **Human-Centered Robot Learning:** Learning from human demonstrations and feedback, adapting to human preferences, and human–robot collaboration.
- **Embodied Agents (Exploring):** I find this area fascinating and am still learning about it.
